name: stage3_euppbench_new_station
registered: 2026-09-26, before any Stage-3 model was trained or any Stage-3 test-period score was computed
purpose: independent validation of the Stage-2 new-station study (protocols/stage2_new_station.json) on a different dataset: EUPPBench v1.0 station data

data.source: EUPPBench v1.0 station data, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.7708362 (EUPPBench-stations.zip, 18,324,361,137 bytes, md5 e409457279b3494d18f2dfb41f3f449b); subset fetched from the official climetlab/ECMWF object store, every file verified by size + CRC32 against the Zenodo zip central directory (scripts/stage3_download.py)
data.not_available: Swiss stations (not in the public dataset: MeteoSwiss data are not openly licensed)
data.station_inclusion_rule: a station is used if it has >= 50% non-missing t2m observations at the 5 lead times both in the reforecast fit+validation period and in the test period; excluded stations are listed in results/stage3/stations.csv. The rule uses data availability only.
data.target: 2 m temperature observation at the station (degC)
data.initialization: 00 UTC; all five lead times verify at 00 UTC
data.ensemble_statistics: for each of the 16 variables: ensemble mean and ensemble standard deviation (ddof=1) over the available members; temperatures (t2m, stl1, mx2t6, mn2t6, t850) converted to degC
data.member_mismatch: training/validation reforecasts have 11 members (control + 10 perturbed), test forecasts have 51. PRIMARY: test statistics from all 51 members (operational use). SENSITIVITY (secondary, same trained models, no refit): test statistics from members 0-10 only (control + first 10 perturbed), matching the training ensemble size.
other_inputs: day-of-year sin and cos of the valid date
station_attributes: CORINE land-use level-1 class of the station, one-hot: artificial (1-11), agricultural (12-22), forest/semi-natural (23-34), wetland (35-39), water/no-data (40-48)
data.missing_values: rows with missing observation or missing t2m ensemble statistics are dropped; any other missing predictor is set to its training mean (0 after standardization); counts reported

periods.fit: reforecast samples whose VALID date is in 1997-2014
periods.early_stopping: reforecast samples whose valid date is in 2015-2016 (training stations only)
periods.excluded: reforecast samples with valid date >= 2017-01-01 (the reforecasts attached to 2018 model dates cover 2017 and would overlap the test period)
periods.test: all 730 daily 00 UTC ensemble forecasts initialized 2017-01-01 ... 2018-12-31, leads 24-120 h (valid 2017-01-02 ... 2019-01-05)
periods.refit: none (network at the best early-stopping epoch; EMOS/boosting fitted on the fit period only, exactly as in Stage 2)

lead_time_handling: ONE network per (variant, fold, seed) with lead-time one-hot inputs, shared station representation across leads (5x fewer runs; each station embedding sees 5x more data; the hidden layer can learn lead interactions). Linear baselines (global EMOS, global boosted EMOS, local boosted EMOS reference) are fitted SEPARATELY PER LEAD TIME, as is standard, because a linear model cannot represent lead-dependent coefficients otherwise.

folds.rule: held-out stations are removed from ALL fitting steps (fit, early stopping, standardization statistics, EMOS/boosting); only their test-period rows are scored as new stations

methods.raw_ensemble_gauss: N(ens mean, ens sd) of t2m
methods.emos_gl: global EMOS per lead time, min-CRPS, fitted on training stations (fit period)
methods.emos_bst_gl: global boosted EMOS per lead time (Gaussian, log-link scale, ML, component-wise boosting on all predictors, standardized response, step 0.05, max 1000 iterations, AIC stopping), fitted on training stations (fit period)
methods.nn_unk: NN with station embedding; unseen stations use the reserved UNK embedding trained with 5% station dropout
methods.nn_knn: same trained networks as nn_unk; unseen-station embedding = IDW mean of the k=5 nearest training stations' embeddings, distance sqrt(d_km^2 + (0.1 km/m * d_alt_m)^2)
methods.nn_noemb: no embedding; station attributes are plain inputs
methods.nn_attr: embedding = MLP(station attributes) -> 2-d, trained jointly, used for all stations
methods.nn_hybrid: PROPOSED in Stage 2 (definition unchanged): embedding = MLP(attributes) + free per-station offset; offset zeroed with probability 0.5 per sample during training; unseen stations use offset 0
methods.nn_hybrid_res: EXPLORATORY: nn_hybrid + residual mean + constrained spread (as Stage 2)
methods.nn_hybrid_knn: EXPLORATORY: nn_hybrid with offset for unseen stations = kNN-IDW mean of training offsets

nn_hyperparameters.note: identical to Stage 2; nothing is tuned

compute.networks: all Stage-3 networks are trained in the same Google Colab GPU environment (NVIDIA T4, CUDA) with torch deterministic algorithms enabled, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8, cudnn.benchmark off; random streams (permutations, dropout masks) are drawn from seeded CPU generators so they do not depend on the device
compute.baselines: EMOS/boosting are deterministic numpy code (run on the Colab CPU)
compute.smoke_test: a tiny pipeline test (1 fold, 1 seed, <=2 epochs, subsampled) was run on a CPU box before Colab; its outputs are discarded and never reported

reference_seen_stations.emos_loc_bst: per-station, per-lead boosted EMOS fitted on each station's fit+validation-period reforecasts (valid 1997-2016), predictors excluding station attributes, AIC stopping, tested on the test period of all stations (seen-station reference)

metrics.primary: mean Gaussian CRPS (degC) over all test rows (5 leads) of held-out stations, pooled over the 7 folds (each station held out exactly once), 10-seed-ensemble forecast (mean of mu and sigma over seeds)
secondary: CRPSS vs raw_ensemble_gauss and vs emos_gl
PIT histogram (10 bins) and reliability index
seen-station CRPS of the same models
CRPS vs distance to nearest training station

significance.test: Diebold-Mariano on the series of per-initialization-date mean CRPS differences (730 dates; mean over held-out stations and the 5 leads), Newey-West lag 5, two-sided, seed-ensemble forecasts
significance.bootstrap: moving-block bootstrap of the same series, block 7 days, 10000 reps, 95% CI of the mean difference
significance.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg q=0.05 across the 6 primary comparisons
significance.station_level: station-wise DM (lag 1) on per-date mean over leads + BH q=0.05; fractions of held-out stations significantly better/worse
significance.secondary_comparisons: all other pairs reported without claims

decision_rules: Claim 'nn_hybrid better than X' only if the BH-adjusted DM test is significant AND the bootstrap CI excludes 0 AND the sign agrees in the spatial-fold check (same rule as Stage 2).
No hyperparameter, variant, predictor or epoch is selected using test-period data. Exploratory methods remain exploratory regardless of results.

replication_hypotheses_from_stage2.H1: every network variant has lower held-out CRPS than emos_gl and emos_bst_gl (random and spatial folds)
replication_hypotheses_from_stage2.H2: on random folds, nn_hybrid, nn_attr and nn_noemb are within 1% of each other and all better than nn_unk
replication_hypotheses_from_stage2.H3: on spatial folds, nn_noemb is better than nn_attr and nn_hybrid
replication_hypotheses_from_stage2.H5: on seen stations nn_hybrid is better than nn_noemb
replication_hypotheses_from_stage2.evaluation: each hypothesis is reported as supported / not supported using the seed-ensemble CRPS and, where a pair is tested, the DM/bootstrap results; no claims beyond these
